source.title: U144: serve the App on a real Daemon so the Enter, Request and Review stages can be rendered against it
source.body:
<!-- work-order:scenarios/ui-first-journey.md:U144 -->
## Outcome
serve the App on a real Daemon so the Enter, Request and Review stages can be rendered against it

## Acceptance
Scenarios: U144
Specification: [scenarios/ui-first-journey.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/ui-first-journey.md)

## Scope
`apps/desktop/vite.config.ts`, `apps/desktop/src/testing/**`, `justfile` (`harness-real`), `.agents/data/harness.md`

## Preserve
U26, U137, S4, D1–D10

## Dependencies
U143

## Delivery
No implementation PR linked yet.

## Queue
Key: U144
Priority: 6
Migration state: ready

Imported from the Work table. The issue-backed queue is being installed; this issue does not create a second Builder. Completion requires delivery evidence, not a matching test name.

goals.statement: With a running `rupd` for a temporary Project, `just harness-real <project-path> <port>` serves `http://localhost:<port>/harness.html?daemon=1`, which mounts the same App with an AppSeam whose `rpc` and `subscribe` are relayed by the dev server over that `rupd`'s socket (`rpc::socket_path`, `RUPD_SOCKET` if set), and whose `project`, `openProject` and `daemonProof` answer from the path given at start.
goals.observer: `u144_` Vitest cases in `apps/desktop/src/testing/` against a real `rupd` started with `crates/rup/tests/e2e/fake_claude.py`, plus an agent-browser headless session on `just harness-real` reading `project` and `daemonProof`

goals.statement: Creating a Room and starting its Door by pointer in the served App puts a Rail row and a Terminal on screen that come from the Daemon, as `rail.tree` and `terminal.list` show, not from a seed.
goals.observer: `u144_a_room_made_and_started_by_pointer_comes_from_the_daemon`, plus agent-browser captures at 1280 by 800 and 700 by 800 in `artifacts/ux/U144/`

goals.statement: In daemon mode the choosers return `null`, the Dock badge does nothing, and closing the socket fires `daemon-exited`, so the App shows U25's failure state.
When a method is called that the real Daemon rejects, the App shows the Daemon's rejection message on screen, not only as an `RpcError` handed to the caller.
goals.observer: A `u144_` Vitest case that reaches a Daemon rejection through the mounted App and asserts that the rendered text contains the Daemon's message

goals.statement: The rest of the App is unchanged: `?seed=` works as before, `vite build` leaves the real-Daemon relay out of `dist`, and the dev server listens only on loopback.
goals.observer: The U26/U137/S4 harness tests stay green, a `vite build` output check for the absence of the relay, and the listening address of `just harness-real`
